name: Camelot Chasma
origin: Home of the Round Table assemblage.

name: Pangea Chasma
origin: Picked up by a Titan in the war with the gods.

name: Herschel
origin: William; German-British astronomer; discovered Mimas and Enceladus (1738-1822).

name: Tintagil Catena
origin: Home of Igraine, Arthur's mother.

name: Avalon Chasma
origin: Arthurian paradise.

name: Oeta Chasma
origin: Shook by a Titan in the war between Titans and Olympians.

name: Pelion Chasma
origin: Mountain piled up with Mt. Ossa in war with gods.

name: Ossa Chasma
origin: Mt. Pelion piled on top of it in war between Titans and Gods.

name: Arthur
origin: King of the Round Table Assemblage.

name: Accolon
origin: Companion of Arthur's; he was tricked into jousting with Arthur.

name: Morgan
origin: Arthur's half sister; enchantress; plotted to destroy Arthur but failed.

name: Gwynevere
origin: Queen; wife of Arthur; lover of Launcelot.

name: Lucas
origin: Butler at King Arthur's court.

name: Melyodas
origin: King of Lyoness; marries King Mark's sister, who dies bearing their son, Sir Tristram.

name: Igraine
origin: Wife of Uther; mother of Arthur.

name: Ban
origin: King of Benwick; father of Sir Launcelot, ally of Arthur in the battle of Bedgrayne.

name: Merlin
origin: Magician and prophet; son of the devil; Arthur's mentor.

name: Pellinore
origin: King whose duty was to pursue the questing beast and either run it to earth or lose his strength.

name: Balin
origin: Knight of "matchless courage and virtue."

name: Dynas
origin: A knight of the Round Table.

name: Bors
origin: King of Gaul; father of Sir Ector de Marys, Sir Bors, Sir Lyonel.

name: Galahad
origin: Bastard son of Launcelot and Elaine. He went on the quest to find the Holy Grail.

name: Marhaus
origin: Delivers poison wound to Tristram before being mortally wounded by him.

name: Uther
origin: Ruler of all Britain; Arthur's father.

name: Launcelot
origin: King Arthur's favorite; champion and lover of Queen Gwynevere.

name: Dagonet
origin: Fool at King Arthur's court.

name: Gawain
origin: Eldest son of King Lot; Arthur's favorite cousin.

name: Modred
origin: Arthur's bastard son and mortal enemy; delivered fatal wound to Arthur but was killed by him.

name: Bedivere
origin: Arthurian knight.

name: Kay
origin: Royal seneschal at Arthur's court.

name: Gaheris
origin: Older son of King Lot; killed by Sir Launcelot in his rescue of Gwynevere from burning.

name: Gareth
origin: Youngest son of King Lot; killed by Sir Launcelot in his rescue of Gwynevere from burning.

name: Royns
origin: King of the West, principal enemy of Arthur.

name: Lot
origin: Leader of the rebel kings of the north and west. Married Margawse and begat Sir Gawain, Sir Aggravayne, Sir Gaheris.

name: Nero
origin: King of the West, principal enemy of Arthur.

name: Elaine
origin: Daughter of King Pelles, lover of Sir Launcelot and mother, by him, of Sir Galahad.

name: Iseult
origin: Loved by Tristram.

name: Mark
origin: King of Cornwall.

name: Lamerok
origin: Pellinore's son; sent testing horn to King Mark to expose adultery of Sir Tristram.

name: Percivale
origin: Very pure knight; accomplished quest of Holy Grail.

name: Tristram
origin: Saved Iseult; fell in love with her.

name: Palomides
origin: Saracen enemy of Tristam.
